review_basis: Independent review of all120frames, relayed by the parent thread.
supersedes: Earlier self-assessment that continuity/force/settling criteria were sufficiently established. Technical geometry continuity remains verified, but convincing weight and intensity were not achieved.

visible_defects.finding: Smoke bends like fabric, with stretched pigment and folded ridges.
Tiny orange flame followed by a mature dense cloud; weak earth jet.
Debris and landings are hard to read; shallow crater smear fails to establish ground weight.

method_conclusion: Continuous mesh deformation alone has not solved authored rupture, rolling forms or ground weight.
source_and_media_preservation: Native checkpoints, videos, images, sourceZIP and Library uploads retained unchanged as diagnostic evidence.
required_before_further_production: A materially different authored-motion and ground-interaction solution. No new approach is implemented or claimed by this status update.
